name: philovoid-memory
description: Persistent, reviewable Philovoid memory workflows for Codex and ChatGPT sessions.

interface.shortDescription: Read, write, search, and consolidate Philovoid project memory.
interface.longDescription: Adds a repo-local memory workflow for Codex and ChatGPT agents working on Philovoid. The plugin keeps active memory separate from dream outputs so curations can be reviewed before promotion.
defaultPrompt: Use Philovoid memory before making repository changes.
Remember this durable project preference in Philovoid memory.
Consolidate Philovoid memory into a reviewable dream output.
